mission.title: ARCHLAND's Mission
mission.description: ARCHLAND Ltd.'s main activity is the construction and sale of modern residential apartments. As a real estate developer, our goal is to create modern, energy-efficient, aesthetically pleasing and liveable homes for future generations as well. During our projects, we pay special attention to environmentally conscious solutions, the application of modern technologies and quality construction.
mission.commitment: In 2009, we completed the Passive House University course and committed ourselves to energy-efficient, environmentally friendly architecture. Since 2010, we have built several residential buildings that operate with geothermal and solar energy, and their energy rating reaches the highest AA++ category: < 40% minimum energy requirement.

history.title: Our History
history.content:
Our roots go back to the 1970s, when my father founded his first construction business. At that time he still worked as a craftsman, today we would say: he became an entrepreneur.

At the end of 1996, we created our first joint venture, PUSIT Ltd. Initially, with a few employees and few tools, we undertook smaller jobs and renovations - our primary goal was to gain experience.

In 2002, the structural construction of the Bem Square apartment building in Debrecen was our first major project, and in the same year we also built the structure of the main building of the Debrecen adventure bath.

From 2003, we built apartment buildings one after another: in Derecske 12, then 20-apartment houses, later in Berettyóújfalu as a main contractor a 27-unit building. Over the years, our knowledge and experience expanded, our business was built on solid foundations: our own site, office, machinery, equipment and excellent professionals help the work.

In 2007, we founded ARCHLAND Ltd. with a new goal: to capitalize on the accumulated experience in building our own designed and constructed apartment buildings.

energyEfficient.title: AA++ RATED HOME
energyEfficient.subtitle: COMFORTABLE, QUIET AND GREEN
energyEfficient.content:
In many parts of the world, the design and construction of energy-efficient buildings is receiving increasing attention. These buildings can be categorized according to the degree of energy savings.

Building reduced energy consumption, or so-called passive houses, is not only a modern technical solution, but also a conscious step towards environmental protection. In this case, we create a low-energy, AA++ energy class building made from environmentally friendly materials and operating with renewable energy sources - for example, solar and geothermal energy. This can also significantly reduce pollutant emissions.

Such buildings are not only energy efficient, but also provide a comfortable living environment. Thanks to the modern structural design, sound insulation is much more effective, thus providing quiet, peaceful living space, especially in urban environments.

The energy requirement of our planned residential buildings is only 20% of the average consumption typical for the given category. The energy required for this is provided primarily by using geothermal and solar energy.

homewell.title: HOMEWELL
homewell.description: The planned 8-apartment building in Hajdúszoboszló, on Szurmai Street, in the spa district, will be built in the immediate vicinity of the beach.
homewell.fullDescription:
The planned 8-apartment HOMEWELL building will be constructed in Hajdúszoboszló's spa district on Szurmai Street, on a fully serviced plot in a well-kept residential area, directly next to the bath complex.

The ground floor will include a shop, a spacious multi-room apartment, eight private garages, a mechanical room, two staircases and an elevator. Five apartments will be created on the first floor and another two on the second floor.

Heating and cooling will be provided by modern heat pumps located in the ground-floor plant room, while a heat recovery ventilation system will ensure fresh air and a comfortable indoor climate.

casaAquila.title: Casa Aquila
casaAquila.description: The Casa Aquila apartment building will be built in the central part of Hajdúszoboszló, on Luther Street, in an orderly residential area.
casaAquila.fullDescription:
Casa Aquila will rise in the heart of Hajdúszoboszló, on Luther Street, in a tidy residential neighbourhood close to the city's key attractions. On the 429 m² building plot a modern, eight-apartment, fully serviced and energy-conscious residential building will be realised.

Sustainability, minimal energy consumption and state-of-the-art construction technology were the guiding principles during planning and execution. Heating and cooling are provided by six 100-metre-deep geothermal probes connected to a ground-floor heat pump system.
